repos.description: ShareX is a free and open-source application that enables users to capture or record any area of their screen with a single keystroke. It also supports uploading images, text, and various file types to a wide range of destinations.
repos.summary_zh: ShareX是一款免费开源的屏幕截图与文件共享工具。它集屏幕捕获、视频录制、图像标注及OCR文字提取于一体，支持自定义工作流与自动化上传，提供轻量、无广告的一站式生产力解决方案。
repos.summary_en: ShareX is a free, open-source, lightweight screen capture, screen recording, and file sharing productivity tool for Windows. It integrates image editing, OCR text extraction, and automated upload workflows into a single ad-free application. Designed for power users, developers, and creators, it offers extensive hotkey support and custom destinations for seamless workflow automation.

repos.description: Multi functional app to find duplicates, empty folders, similar images etc.
repos.summary_zh: Czkawka/Krokiet 是一款基于 Rust 的多功能跨平台桌面应用，专注于快速查找并清理系统中的重复文件、空文件夹、相似图片及临时文件等。它拥有高效的多线程算法和友好的 GUI/CLI 界面，支持多平台运行且无广告、无联网，是强大的系统清理与维护工具。
repos.summary_en: Czkawka is a fast, memory-safe Rust utility for finding and removing clutter like duplicate files, empty folders, similar images, and temporary files. Offering multiplatform support, efficient multithreading, cache scanning, and both GUI and CLI frontends, it provides a private, ad-free system cleaning solution.

repos.description: Remove large amounts of unwanted applications quickly.
repos.summary_zh: 批量强力系统卸载工具，专为快速清理大量冗余应用而生。支持批量静默卸载、深度残留清理及孤儿软件检测，兼容Windows商店、Steam及多种安装格式，极大简化IT系统维护与软件清理流程。
repos.summary_en: Bulk Crap Uninstaller (BCUninstaller) is a powerful, free Windows desktop utility designed for rapid batch uninstallation of unwanted applications. It excels at cleaning system leftovers, detecting orphaned software, and automating mass removals with minimal user input, offering deep integration for Windows Store, Steam, and various installer formats.
